rulepack.label: TEST ONLY: synthetic rules for exercising the engine. Not a methodology and not a compliance check.

rules.title: Net electricity exported is missing
rules.message: No reviewed value was found for net electricity exported. {detail}
rules.remediation: Provide the net exported electricity for the monitoring period, with its source document.

rules.title: Monitoring period start date is missing
rules.message: No reviewed monitoring period start date was found. {detail}
rules.remediation: Provide the start date as stated in the monitoring report.

rules.title: Monitoring period end date is missing
rules.message: No reviewed monitoring period end date was found. {detail}
rules.remediation: Provide the end date as stated in the monitoring report.

rules.title: Period end is not after period start
rules.message: The period dates are out of order. Observed {observed}.
rules.remediation: Check the dates in the source document and correct the extracted values.

rules.title: Document period differs from the monitoring period
rules.message: {subject} in the document is {observed} but the monitoring period has {expected}.
rules.remediation: Align the monitoring period with the document, or confirm which one is right.

rules.title: Net electricity exported has an unsuitable unit
rules.remediation: Use an energy unit such as MWh or kWh and state it next to the figure.

rules.title: Emission factor has an unsuitable unit
rules.remediation: State the factor as tonnes of CO2 per MWh, or a unit that converts to it.

rules.title: Installed capacity is outside the test range
rules.remediation: Confirm the capacity figure and its unit in the source document.

rules.title: Documents disagree on net electricity exported
rules.message: Reviewed values for net electricity exported differ: {observed}.
rules.remediation: Find which document is correct and correct or explain the other.

rules.title: Monthly exports do not add up to the reported total
rules.message: The monthly values do not match the reported total. Observed {observed}.
rules.remediation: Reconcile the monthly meter readings with the reported total.

rules.title: Claimed emission reductions do not match the recomputation
rules.message: The claimed figure {observed} differs from the recomputed {expected}.
rules.remediation: Check the inputs and the arithmetic in the report.
